info.name: Whatsapp
info.description:
## Whatsapp

Admin-only WhatsApp session management. All endpoints return `503` when `WHATSAPP_DRIVER=stub` — the provider guard short-circuits before the handler.

### Base URL
`{{base_url}}/api/v1`

### Authentication
All endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer {{admin_access_token}}`.

### Environment Variables
| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `base_url` | API base URL |
| `admin_access_token` | Admin JWT (auto-set on login) |

item.name: Admin
item.description: WhatsApp session lifecycle and ad-hoc sending. All requests require an admin access token and a non-stub WhatsApp driver.

request.description:
### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| phone | string | YES | Syrian phone, normalized to international form. |
| text | string | YES | Message body, up to 4096 chars. |

### Notes
Routes through the same paced queue OTPs use, so rapid manual triggers can't bypass the anti-ban throttle. Returns `202 Accepted` with a queue position — delivery is asynchronous.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 422 | Validation failed |
| 503 | `WHATSAPP_DRIVER=stub` — endpoint disabled |

### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
None — operates on the server's persisted Baileys session.

### Notes
Unpairs the WhatsApp account and wipes local credentials, freeing `/qr` to pair a different phone number.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 503 | `WHATSAPP_DRIVER=stub` — endpoint disabled |

### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
None.

### Notes
Returns the current pairing QR code as a base64 data URL. Scan from the WhatsApp mobile app under *Linked devices* to pair this server.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 503 | `WHATSAPP_DRIVER=stub` — endpoint disabled |

### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
None.

### Notes
Returns `{ connected, paired }` — `connected` is the live socket state, `paired` reflects whether persisted credentials exist on disk.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 503 | `WHATSAPP_DRIVER=stub` — endpoint disabled |
